q: What was the relationship between Boaz and Naomi’s dead husband?
a: Boaz was a relative of Naomi’s husband.

q: What did Naomi tell Ruth to do before going down to the threshing floor?
a: She told her to wash and anoint herself and to put on her cloak.

q: What was the second agreement that Boaz said the elders had witnessed?
a: They had witnessed that Boaz acquired Ruth as his wife.
